name: word-page
description: Write like in Word or Google Docs inside VS Code: Quarto's visual editor as a white page with black text under any colour theme, plus a command for a new document. The file underneath stays markdown (.qmd). Personal add-on.

commands.title: Word Page: Put the White Page Back
Word Page: Highlighted Text to the Claude Chat Box

wordPage.enabled.description: Show Quarto's visual editor as a white page with black text, whatever the colour theme of VS Code. Off: the visual editor follows the theme again.

enumDescriptions: The page as a paper's PDF (LaTeX): the Latin Modern font, an A4 page with 2.5 cm margins, text straight on both sides, the PDF's heading sizes.
A Word-like page: your own editor font, wider line distance, text straight on the left only.
wordPage.look.description: How the page looks. Close the document tab and open it again after a change.

wordPage.pageWidth.description: Width of the page in pixels (text plus margins). In the PDF look this is the zoom: text size and margins grow with the page.

wordPage.foldCode.description: PDF look: fold the header, R chunks and raw LaTeX, as the PDF does not show them. The header becomes the title block, the others one grey line; a click opens them. Close the document tab and open it again after a change.

wordPage.pageEnds.description: PDF look: a dashed line with the page number where each page of the PDF next to the document starts (draft.qmd -> draft.pdf), read again each time the PDF changes. Needs Python with PyMuPDF (pip install pymupdf).

wordPage.python.description: The Python that reads the PDF for the page ends (needs the package PyMuPDF).
